tolerance_policy.rationale: Declared before running. Native f32 and this f32 oracle differ only in reduction order, so per-vector cosine and pairwise scores must agree closely. The card's precision and hardware are unstated (its own vLLM numbers differ from its Transformers numbers by about 2.5e-3), so the card anchor uses a looser bound and checks recipe, not arithmetic.
